children: The Subcontract Works comprise the complete design, supply, off-loading, distribution, setting-out and installation of the Subcontract Works, all as detailed within this Scope of Works and in accordance with the Subcontract.
The Subcontract includes, but is not limited to:
{b:Working Hours:} The Works are to be executed between {Mon-Fri} Monday to Friday and {Sat} Saturday and the Subcontractor is to allow for all costs associated with working during these hours.

The Subcontractor is deemed to have visited the site, to have taken into account all local and existing conditions and to be thoroughly acquainted with the position and accessibility of the Subcontract works and the conditions under which they will have to be carried out. Claims based on lack of knowledge will not be entertained.

{CompanyName} shall not provide any site security personnel. The Subcontractor is therefore to make arrangements and be responsible for all its material and plant. All materials and plant left on site is at the Subcontractors own risk.

When undertaking the design of the Subcontract Works, the Subcontractor shall use all the reasonable skill, care and diligence to be expected of an architect, or other professionally qualified designer, who is experienced in undertaking design of an equal or similar nature, size and complexity to that of the Subcontract Works.

The Subcontractor is to ensure its design is in accordance with the Subcontract documents, employers requirements, British Standards, and Industry regulations, including but not limited to the Building Regulations.

No provision of this Subcontract shall operate to exclude or restrict the Subcontractors liability under statute or common law for any goods and materials he shall supply, or has supplied, for use on, or incorporation in the Subcontract Works.
The Subcontractor is to follow the Design Submission Procedure as provided for in Schedule 6 of the JCT Conditions.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is to ensure its design is in accordance with the Subcontract documents, employers requirements, British Standards, and Industry regulations, including but not limited to the Building Regulations.
The Subcontractor shall be responsible for the management of the Subcontract programme and will produce and regularly update a programme - providing a copy of such to {CompanyName} as upon request.
The Subcontractor must adhere to all aspects of {CompanyName} Project Quality Procedures, Health & Safety Plan and Management Protocols.

The Subcontractor shall submit a formal Method Statement plus Risk Assessments for all site activities to {CompanyName} for review, comment and approval ahead of commencement on site, not less than 7 days prior to its proposed start date on site.
The Subcontract Works shall not be further subcontracted without the express permission of {CompanyName}.

All operatives engaged in the execution of the Subcontract Works must be experienced and skilled in their particular discipline and appropriately qualified. Additionally, all operatives shall be CSCS certified.

All personnel operating mechanical plant must be fully and properly trained and possess a valid certificate of training and competence. All personnel constructing scaffolding or mobile towers must be properly trained and in possession of valid certification. Copies of all operatives qualifications/certifications, together with National Insurance details must be provided to {CompanyName} if requested.

{CompanyName} may provide a primary datum and gridlines for the site. If this is the case, the Subcontractor is then responsible for detailed setting out/site measurement/survey of the Subcontract Works from and therefore the correct positioning of each element.

The Subcontractor will be responsible for logistical planning, taking delivery of, unloading and distributing all component elements of the Subcontract Works. If distribution assistance is required this may be possible subject to prior agreement with {CompanyName}. In all cases however, the slinger/banksman is the responsibility of the Subcontractor and {CompanyName} do not accept any liability for handling the Subcontractors goods and materials.

The Subcontractor shall be responsible for all plant items provided by {CompanyName} when they are under the control of the Subcontractor. Any damage rectification costs to the said items will be the responsibility of the Subcontractor. All other plant items and equipment necessary for the complete installation of the Subcontract Works will be provided by the Subcontractor.
The Subcontractor must allow for all reasonable measures required to overcome the effects of adverse weather.

The Secondary Sub-Contractor will be responsible for all Subcontract materials and tools on site. The Subcontractor will supply all small tools (associated accessories & consumables) plus any temporary task lighting, necessary for the execution of the Subcontract works in their entirety.
The Subcontractor shall provide all other installation accessories, including but not restricted to Heras (or equivalent) fencing, all requisite signage, and installation plant.

The Subcontractor shall wipe down all elements of the Subcontract Works to ensure that all labels, plus any marks associated with installation and storage, are The Employer’s Agentd as part of the installation process.

The Subcontractor shall supply, install, reasonably maintain, The Employer’s Agent and dispose of protection materials for the Subcontract Works. The risk in the Subcontract Works shall remain with the Subcontractor until Practical Completion.

The Subcontractor must take all reasonable measures to ensure that no damage is caused to works of any other trade. Any damage will be notified to the Subcontractor with the associated costs deducted from monies due to the Subcontractor or recovered as a debt. The Subcontractor has included for all necessary provisions to ensure that the Contractor is able to achieve the appropriate certification/approval from Building Control.
The Subcontractor must adhere and allow for complying with all {CompanyName} and Statutory Health and Safety requirements.
All electrical tools and appliances must be inspected, tagged and maintained in accordance with prevalent safety legislation.

The Subcontractor is to provide his operatives with all necessary protective equipment free of charge, including but not restricted to hard hats, safety boots, high visibility vests, goggles, gloves and safety harnesses.
The Subcontractor shall ensure that a high standard of housekeeping is maintained throughout the Subcontract Works, with all arisings broken down, de-nailed (if necessary) and deposited in skips.

The Subcontractor shall The Employer’s Agent all plant, equipment and facilities associated with the Subcontract Works from site as and when directed by {CompanyName} or upon the completion of the Subcontract works, whichever is the sooner.
